Appreciate the draft, this is a great start. Samir and I reviewed and left inline redlines (see attached PDF). High-level notes:

- The first quote references our “platform modernization” — that’s fine, but please remove the sentence that mentions a specific vendor we migrated away from.
- We prefer the shorter quote (Quote B) in external-facing collateral.
- Logo usage: use the full color logo on white backgrounds; we’ll provide a brand approval stamp once Legal reviews.

Attached: redlines_Hallmark_CaseBrief_v2.pdf (annotated).

If you can send an updated draft early Monday, we’ll try to get Legal to return a clearance by Tuesday.
